programme.desc: 'S15/E1'. Die geliefde Charl Munnick wat die samelewing opgehelder het met sy liefdadigheid, word tydens 'n rooftog in sy juwelierswinkel koelbloedig doodgeskiet. Vier mans is vir die moord en roof gearresteer.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S15/E3'. 'n Vrolike dag by die sirkus verander in 'n chaotiese tragedie wanneer die sirkus-tent na 'n hewige storm op die sirkusgangers inmekaarstort. Minstens 120 mense is beseer en 'n jong kind is oorlede.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S15/E4'. Was dit jaloesie? 'n Gebroke hart? Die effekte van emosionele trauma? Hierdie vra bly oor nadat Lesley-Ann Damons die 9-jarige Quinisha Sebrandt strand toe gevat het om te gaan swem, en toe vermoor het...

programme.title: Verander jou siening
programme.desc: 'S1/E8'. Daneel van der Walt, teater- en TV-aktrise, kry 'n kykie agter die gordyn van die lewe van Christelle Dreyer, 'n danser met Osteogenesis imperfecta.

programme.title: Gholftoer
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. In die eerste episode besoek ek en gholfmaat Lourens ('n klub-pro) die Metropolitan-gholfbaan langs my gunstelingrugbystadion.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S32/E1'. Die vrugteboer en bedryfsleier Calla du Toit is die hele tyd besig om nie net sy eie familieboerdery nie, maar ook die groter vrugtebedryf te bevorder en posisioneer.

programme.title: Goeiemôre, good morning
programme.desc: 'S2/E21'. Dié ontbytprogram sal seker maak Suid-Afrikaners begin hulle dag met al die inligting wat hulle kort. Ons dek alles van gebeure wat saakmaak en finansies tot leefstylkwessies en vermaak.

programme.title: Die Tuinmakers
programme.desc: 'S1/E11'. Volgens Craig de Necker is jou tuin die grootste vertrek van jou huis. Vir hom is tuinmaak 'n dialoog tussen mens en natuur, waar hy luister, ondersoek en skep.

programme.title: Die Oomblik
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Afrikaans is Groot is die grootste musiekkonsert in Suid-Afrika. Kyk hoe die organiseerders daarin slaag om hul visie 'n werklikheid te maak en hoeveel voorbereiding en beplanning in dié produksie ingaan.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S18/E9'. Op 7 Februarie 2020 is Tazne van Wyk (8) ontvoer. 10 dae later is 'n verdagte in hegtenis geneem. Op 19 Februarie is haar lyk in 'n stormwaterdrein langs die N1 buite Worcester gevind nadat die verdagte die plek uitgewys het.

programme.title: Goeiemôre, good morning
programme.desc: 'S2/E21'. Dié ontbytprogram sal seker maak Suid-Afrikaners begin hulle dag met al die inligting wat hulle kort. Ons dek alles van gebeure wat saakmaak en finansies tot leefstylkwessies en vermaak.

programme.title: Ons Gesels Balans
programme.desc: 'S2/E3'. Hierdie week gesels Katryn met Clarice de Jonge oor die beginsels van 'n gesonde roetine.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E13'. FruitLips van Piket-Bo-Berg in die W-Kaap produseer jaarliks tot 325 000 botteltjies konfyt, marmelade en ingelegde vrugte - onder leiding van Liebré Jacobs op die familieplaas, Achtervlei.

programme.title: Dorpie-doenlys
programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. Van bekroonde wynkelders tot rustige plattelandse blyplekke, staproetes en prentjiemooi valleie - ons wys jou al die dinge wat Wellington so besonders maak.

programme.title: Mooi Praatjies
programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. Cindy ontdek die 'Glass Skin'-beweging. Dr. Maureen Allem bespreek behandelings wat jou vel nuwe lewe gee.

programme.title: Goeiemôre, good morning
programme.desc: 'S2/E21'. Dié ontbytprogram sal seker maak Suid-Afrikaners begin hulle dag met al die inligting wat hulle kort. Ons dek alles van gebeure wat saakmaak en finansies tot leefstylkwessies en vermaak.

programme.title: Koffie & kapitaal
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Jeanette Marais, uitvoerende hoof van die Momentum Groep, gesels oor 'n koppie koffie met Theo Vorster oor die besluite, waardes en beginsels wat haar leierskap rig en die groep se merkwaardige groei dryf.

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S8/E16 - Merida'. Andrew Zimmern explores the cuisine of Merida, Mexico. He tries traditional slow-roasted pork, pork-stuffed cheese balls in Yucatan sauces and much more!

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S8/E17 - El Paso'. Andrew Zimmern is in El Paso, Texas, to dive into its rich food culture. He tries everything from traditional fajitas and menudo to rolled tacos and entomatadas.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Anime Pilgrims
programme.desc: We head to Nagasaki, the backdrop of the 2024 acclaimed film The Colours Within, with anime singer and super-fan MindaRyn from Thailand. Uncover the reality behind Japan's 'hidden Christian' history.

programme.title: Core Kyoto Mini
programme.desc: Elegant and practical, braided cords are essential for kimonos and other aspects of everyday life.

programme.title: Easy Japanese For Work
programme.desc: Binod-san from Nepal works at a car sales company as a mechanic, but he's not sure what to do when he doesn't understand his superior's instructions in Japanese. He learns how to clarify and confirm.

programme.title: Zero Waste Life
programme.desc: Trash Tribe is a band led by Oomote Fumiaki whose instruments are made with marine trash. Fishing line and driftwood on strings, plastic bottle percussion - their laid-back music has fans of all ages.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Somewhere Street
programme.desc: Philadelphia, the City of Brotherly Love, is the US East Coast's second-largest city after NYC - it's the birthplace of the US and was once the capital, and it's now a favourite for history buffs.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Empowering Kids Through Song
programme.desc: A Brazilian woman living in Japan tries to promote a music video that she made for kids about sexual abuse while navigating the differences between the two cultures.

programme.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change The World
programme.desc: Wild elephants entering human living areas, causing accidents and crop damage, is a problem across Asia. What will happen to elephant-human coexistence as their habitats shift due to climate change?

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Aichi / Kataoka Mami (curator). Tokoname, a pottery town with over 900 years of history, creates products appropriate for the times. Kataoka finds the beauty that's present in functional objects.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: Our team visits the National Printing Bureau in Tokyo where Japan's banknotes are made, and gets a rare look at their state-of-the-art printing technology and meet their top-secret banknote artists.

programme.title: Time-Lapse Japan
programme.desc: As the samurai age ended, citrus production provided a way forward for former warriors in Hagi. Locals still love century-old sweets made using the aromatic skin. Watch them being made in time-lapse.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: The Seasons Of Yamato
programme.desc: A series of poetic videos by Koichi Hozan, a videographer living in Nara, in collaboration with pianist Mine Kawakami - for which she plays exclusive pieces - helps you experience each season.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Lava Flows: The hazard map for Mount Fuji was revised in 2021, revealing the chance of more damage from lava flows - we look at what lies behind the assumptions and what countermeasures can be taken.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history, and culture - this episode looks at words related to Japanese sweets. Explore the unique culture behind them.
